subject: Request to Hold Capacity for Hypatia — late-stage commitment (HY-3482)
messages:
From: Samira Qureshi <samira@hypatia.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@hypatia.ai>
Date: 2026-07-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Capacity hold request for HY-3482

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the call this morning. We're preparing the final procurement packet and expect PO sig in ~2–3 weeks, but given our Q4 ramp plan we need to lock an allocation now to avoid model-training queue risk. Target: dedicated pool with 8x A100-80GB (preferred) for inference + 2x A40 for staging, region us-west.

Can Redwood place a 30-day soft hold / standby on that capacity while legal & finance finish the contract? We'll accept the hold fee if required — want to avoid losing the slot. Also attaching an updated SKU matrix and SOC2 snapshot for your security review.

Attachments: hypatia_sku_matrix.xlsx (stub), hypatia_soc2_evidence.pdf (stub)

Appreciate a quick confirmation of what you can reserve and any steps you need from our side.

—Samira
Head of Platform
Hypatia AI

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samira Qureshi <samira@hypatia.ai>
Date: 2026-07-01T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity hold request for HY-3482

Team — forwarding Hypatia's formal ask. Quick summary: external requests 8x A100-80GB + 2x A40 in us-west, 30d soft hold while PO completes. They will accept hold fee.

Questions for ops/capacity:
- Can we soft-hold that exact SKU mix (A100-80GB x8 + A40 x2) in us-west for 30 days?
- If exact A100-80GB unavailable, what compatible fallback variants do we have (eg A100-40 + packing/tiling notes)?
- Any implications to existing late-stage commitments this week?

Ben/Monica — please treat as high-priority; customer is in final legal loop. Karthik — if there are quantization/packing levers that would let us offer a smaller physical footprint with equivalent tokens/sec, flag that.

I'll confirm back to Samira once we have a clear path.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-02T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity hold request for HY-3482

Rachel — I ran a quick inventory/booking check with fleet. Current us-west pool free capacity (uncommitted):
- A100-80GB: 10 units available
- A40: 5 units available

We have three near-term committed starts next week that could consume up to 4 A100-80GB (staggered). Given that, we can place a soft standby hold for 8 A100-80GB + 2 A40 for 30 days, but we should mark it as "provisional standby" with a fallthrough policy: if an identical-latency enterprise SLA kickoff (higher-tier reserved contract) lands, we may require a 72h notice to Hypatia to either sign PO or accept a reduced allocation.

Recommended hold command (ops): standby:HY-3482(manifest=8xA100-80GB;2xA40;region=us-west;duration=30d;policy=provisional).

Attachments: proposed_hold_runbook.txt (stub) — includes change control and billing flag.

If Sales prefers firm block, we'll need finance to approve a non-refundable deposit and ops to do a hard block; that will require a signed SOW.

Ben
Director, Capacity Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-03T11:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity hold request for HY-3482

Notes from infra sizing side:
- If Hypatia will accept A100-80GB equivalents, we can offer 8x A100-80GB logical by packing 16x A100-40GB + optimized kernel mapping; that reduces physical GPU requirements but adds ~6% latency variance for 99th pct under peak.
- Quantization to int4 on their model gives 1.6x throughput improvement; if they can accept lower FP fidelity for inference endpoints, we can suggest 6x A100-80GB equivalent instead of 8. That would help fleet flexibility.

Ops wise, provisional standby as Ben suggested is fine; I'll add two fallback variants into the manifest so automated routing can downgrade to:
  fallback-1: 8xA100-80GB (explicit)
  fallback-2: 6xA100-80GB-equivalent (packed: 16xA100-40GB + int4 quant)

I'll prepare a short note for the customer outlining performance tradeoffs to help them decide quickly.

—Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samira Qureshi <samira@hypatia.ai>, Hypatia Legal <legal@hypatia.ai>
Date: 2026-07-05T09:50:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity hold request for HY-3482 — hold fee and legal note

Hi all — finance/legal input:
- We can approve a 30-day provisional standby with a refundable hold fee equal to 10% of the month-to-month expected committed spend (to be invoiced on hold placement). Refundable if PO signed within 30 days; forfeited if canceled by customer.
- We'll need a short amendment to the MSA to capture the provisional standby terms. Hypatia legal, can you confirm acceptance of the clause below?

Provisional Standby Clause (proposed): Redwood will place a provisional standby hold on specified capacity for 30 days. Customer will be invoiced a hold fee equal to 10% of the estimated monthly spend for the held resources. If a firm purchase order covering the held capacity is executed within 30 calendar days, the fee will be credited to the first invoice; if not, the fee is forfeited and Redwood may reallocate resources.

Attachments: proposal_v3.pdf (stub) — includes the proposed amendment language.

Monica Patel
Sr. Finance Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Qureshi <samira@hypatia.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Hypatia Legal <legal@hypatia.ai>
Date: 2026-07-07T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Capacity hold request for HY-3482 — confirmed provisional standby

Samira — thanks for the quick turnaround on the docs. Per internal checks we can place the provisional standby as requested. Summary of agreed items: 

- Resources held: 8 x A100-80GB (primary) + 2 x A40 (staging), region: us-west.
- Hold type: provisional standby (30 days) — command: standby:HY-3482(manifest=8xA100-80GB;2xA40;region=us-west;duration=30d;policy=provisional).
- Fallbacks: fallback-1 (exact), fallback-2 (packed equivalent 6x A100-80GB-equivalent using A100-40 + int4 quant) — automated routing may apply fallback if firm commitments require reallocation.
- Financials: refundable hold fee = 10% estimated monthly spend; invoice will be issued on placement. If PO is signed within 30 days fee credits to first invoice.
- Next steps for Hypatia: reply to this thread confirming acceptance of provisional standby terms and attach any final PO timing. Legal and finance teams can sign the short amendment (proposal_v3).

We will place the provisional hold when you confirm and once we have permission to invoice the hold fee. Ops will return the standby reference id in a follow-up (expected within 2 business hours of placement).

—Rachel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: hypatia_sku_matrix.xlsx (stub), hypatia_soc2_evidence.pdf (stub)
